title: Ask HN: I'm a Linux guy. Tell me about all those BSDs
guide_zh: 长期使用 Linux 的作者，希望了解各个 BSD 系统的特点和实际体验。
author: ghotli
excerpt: I use Linux and I have for nearly all of my teenage and adult life. I had a short foray into Solaris; ZFS was nice, and so were the raid tools. Otherwise I found it to be rather tedious. Tell me, why would I ever want to use one of those BSDs over Linux of some sort? What's the allure?

title: Ask HN: Tips for Hackers having Kids?
guide_zh: 孩子即将出生，习惯长时间工作的黑客该如何准备成为父母？
author: thegyppo
excerpt: In about 6 months I've got a lovely bundle of joy coming into the world, needless to say I'm extremely excited. Like many Hackers I work fairly long hours, especially weekends (sometimes when I get my best work done).
